Resolves #18849

The three portal news views import the bundled `dist/marked.mjs`, the way `src/` has since the portable-dependencies work. Their old specifier — `'../../../../../node_modules/marked/lib/marked.esm.js'` — resolves only while neo is the repository root; a consumer compiles these files anyway (the App worker's lazy webpack context spans `node_modules/neo.mjs/apps`), so its `build-all` exited 1 with three `Module not found` errors.

Evidence: L3 (a real consumer workspace, engine `dev@3f859a4803`: red control and green proof at one head) → L3 required (AC-3 is a consumer build). Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: mechanical — three identical one-line specifier changes, same depth, no behaviour delta (`src/` already imports this artifact).

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | outside-CI: `git grep -n -E "^\s*import .*from '(\.\./)+node_modules/" -- apps examples docs/app src` → 0 lines (3 before) |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `unit/apps/portal/view/news/**` + `unit/app/content/**` (39 arms import these components) |
| AC-3 | outside-CI, run pre-merge rather than deferred: the three fixed files copied into a consumer's installed engine → `build-all` rc=0 **twice in a row**, 0 webpack errors. Control at the same consumer head without them: second run rc=1, `webpack 5.111.0 compiled with 3 errors` |

## Deltas from ticket

None substantive. AC-3 was written as post-merge; it is discharged here, with its control.

## Test Evidence

- Why only the SECOND consumer build failed: the consumer's postinstall bridge copies `marked` under `node_modules/neo.mjs/node_modules/` until `dist/marked.mjs` exists; the first `build-all` creates that file, the next `npm i` prunes the copy and the bridge stands down — exactly as designed, which left these three imports with nothing to resolve.
- Neither existing guard can see it: the engine's own build resolves the path at the repo root, and `check-consumer-runtime-build` builds a fixture's Data worker and Main, never the App worker.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] At the Institution pin that carries this commit: `build-all` twice in a row, 0 errors, no patched files.

**Findings:**

- **Observer gap → #18868, filed and self-assigned (discharged in-place).** No check here can fail on this class. `build-all` resolves the old path at the root. `check-consumer-runtime-build` compiles only `worker: 'data'` plus Main, and covers `marked` through hand-listed fixture imports. `consumer-runtime-build.yml`'s path filter has no `apps/` path. #18849 called this "worth its own ticket", and nothing carried it.
